import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

q = Path(__file__).parent

def normalize(asm, addr, size):
    lines = []
    for line in asm.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s*(.*)', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        s = re.split(r'\s+#\s+', m[2], maxsplit=1)[0]
        s = re.sub(r'-?0x[0-9a-f]+\(%rip\)', 'RIP_DISPLACEMENT(%rip)', s)
        branch = re.match(r'^(j\w+|call)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+<(.*)>$', s)
        if branch:
            t = int(branch[2], 16)
            s = branch[1] + ' ' + (f'LOCAL_{t-addr:x}' if addr <= t < addr+size else branch[3])
        lines.append(f'{int(m[1], 16)-addr:x}: ' + ' '.join(s.split()))
    return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

def inspect(binary, prefix):
    records, normalized = {}, {}
    symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-S', '-C', str(binary)], text=True)
    for line in symbols.splitlines():
        if 'cast_numeric_arrays::<arrow_array::types::Int16Type, arrow_array::types::Int64Type>' in line:
            key = 'dispatch'
        elif 'cast_numeric_sparse::<arrow_array::types::Int16Type, arrow_array::types::Int64Type>' in line:
            key = 'sparse'
        elif 'try_numeric_cast<arrow_array::types::Int16Type, arrow_array::types::Int64Type>' in line and 'try_unary::' in line:
            key = 'fallback'
        else:
            continue
        assert key not in records
        addr, size, _, name = line.split(maxsplit=3)
        addr, size = int(addr, 16), int(size, 16)
        asm = subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', '-C', '--no-show-raw-insn', f'--start-address={addr}', f'--stop-address={addr+size}', str(binary)], text=True)
        (q/f'{prefix}-{key}.asm').write_text(asm)
        normalized[key] = normalize(asm, addr, size)
        records[key] = {'name': name, 'address': hex(addr), 'size_bytes': size, 'instruction_count': len(normalized[key].splitlines()), 'normalized_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized[key].encode()).hexdigest()}
    return records, normalized

records, normalized = {}, {}
for label, binary in {'before':q/'widen-bench-before', 'after':q/'widen-bench-after', 'committed':q/'widen-committed', 'direct':q/'widen-infallible', 'sql':q/'after-bench'}.items():
    records[label], normalized[label] = inspect(binary, 'final-'+label)
assert normalized['after']['dispatch'] == normalized['direct']['dispatch']
assert normalized['after']['sparse'] == normalized['direct']['sparse'] == normalized['sql']['sparse']
assert 'fallback' not in records['after']
layouts = []
for build in json.loads((q/'layout-diagnosis.json').read_text())['builds']:
    seed, variant = build['seed'], build['variant']
    key = 'sparse' if variant == 'after' else 'fallback'
    asm = (q/f'layout/{seed}-{variant}.asm').read_text()
    result = normalize(asm, int(build['fallback_address'],16), build['fallback_size'])
    assert result == normalized[variant][key]
    layouts.append({'seed':seed, 'variant':variant, 'normalized_matches_final':True})
record = {'symbols':records, 'cargo_dispatch_matches_direct_build':True, 'cargo_sparse_matches_direct_and_sql_build':True, 'layouts':layouts, 'normalization':'Offsets from function start, local branch offsets, named external calls, RIP displacements/comments omitted; not raw byte equivalence.'}
(q/'final-assembly.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
